name: corrosive form
desc:
A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes.
After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed after dealing damage. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.
